channel.title: The Velocity White Papers: Audio Summary
channel.description: A five-episode audio summary of The Velocity White Papers (Government of Alberta, Ministry of Technology and Innovation, June 2026, MIT licensed). Unofficial summary generated with AI voices.
channel.itunes:author: Velocity Papers Summary
channel.itunes:summary: Unofficial five-episode audio summary of the 21 Velocity White Papers.

item.title: Episode 1: Defining the problem
item.description: Papers 1 to 5: the two-billion-dollar Ship of Theseus, the cyber imperative, Git Insights, Git Insights Ministry, and the four approaches to AI modernization.

item.title: Episode 2: The harness and the agent teams
item.description: Papers 6 and 7: the well-built harness, and the red, blue, green, and yellow agent teams.

item.title: Episode 3: The AI Factory and the agentic stack
item.description: Papers 8 to 12: Pronghorn, Nexus, the Velocity Game Engine, the five-months-to-four-days case study, and the agentic technology stack.

item.title: Episode 4: People and change management
item.description: Papers 13 to 16: the AI Academy, builder culture, the compression problem, and measuring failure and success.

item.title: Episode 5: Technical appendix and the shape of data
item.description: Papers 17 to 21 and the appendices: anatomy of a template, the anti-drift harness, the canvas, Government 3.0, and the shape of data.
